jobs.description: ← DEX nieuws M&A advisor vacancy Read document text VACANCY: DEX international M&A is looking for an M&A advisor DEX international M&A is an independent mid-market advisory firm advising business owners, investors and large corporations on mergers and acquisitions. Founded in 2015, DEX has successfully completed over 50 transactions, with typical transaction values ranging from €10 million to €150+ million. The majority of transactions are cross-border. The team is currently made up of 6 M&A professionals and 1 support staff working from our offices in Oisterwijk. Clients are both Dutch and international entrepreneurs, private equity firms and medium to large sized businesses. DEX works in close collaboration with Globalscope partner firms. With an ever increasing dealflow, DEX is looking to strengthen its team with an M&A advisor. Working at DEX implies working in teams, however with an independent mind-set and taking responsibility from day one. Tasks and responsibilities are diverse and vary across all stages of the transaction process.
